## Architecture Overview

The `Matcher` struct is defined in `prometheus/model/labels/matcher.go` with a `Matches(s string) bool` method. It is used across the entire observability stack for label filtering in queries and alerting rules. Changing to `Matches(v string) (bool, error)` requires updating every call site across prometheus, thanos, mimir, grafana, and loki.

## Detailed Analysis

### Core Definition

- **`model/labels/matcher.go`** — Matcher struct with Type, Name, Value fields and compiled regex. `Matches()` method switches on MatchType (Equal, NotEqual, Regexp, NotRegexp).

### Prometheus Callers

- **`promql/parser/parse.go`** — PromQL parsing checking if matchers apply to empty values.
- **`rules/group.go`** — Alert rule evaluation.
- **`tsdb/querier.go`** — TSDB querier filtering.
- **`web/api/v1/api.go`** — API label filtering.

### Thanos

- **`pkg/store/bucket.go`** — Block metadata matching against external labels.
- **`pkg/store/tsdb.go`** — TSDB store filtering.
- **`pkg/store/proxy.go`** — Store proxy implementation.
- **`pkg/compactv2/modifiers.go`** — Compaction modifiers.

### Mimir

- **`pkg/ingester/activeseries/model/matchers.go`** — Active series tracking.
- **`pkg/storegateway/bucket.go`** — Store gateway bucket operations.
- **`pkg/querier/tenantfederation/tenant_federation.go`** — Tenant federation querying.
- **`pkg/frontend/querymiddleware/labels_query_optimizer.go`** — Query middleware optimization.

### Loki

- **`pkg/logql/log/label_filter.go`** — Label filtering in LogQL.
- **`pkg/ingester/tailer.go`** — Log tailer filtering.

| thanos | pkg/store/tsdb.go | TSDB store filtering |
